//: Fixed wording for the office tasks (core/testrooms/office, from PR #6): each task's title, a one-line brief for the model, its narrator and character lines, and the labels drawn on its props.

balloons.title: The office party
balloons.brief: A small room being decorated for an office party: a table with a balloon pump, a party score on the whiteboard, a banner.

lines.intro: The office party is this afternoon. The balloons won't inflate themselves.
lines.pop: That one's gone. There are more.
lines.done: That's the last of the balloons.

labels.scoreInspect: The party score. Points for every balloon that makes it to the party.

coffee.title: The break room
coffee.brief: A break room with three coffee machines side by side, labelled A, B and C.

lines.advice: Machine {machine} is the good one. Everyone swears by it.
lines.empty: The machines are out of cups.

canteen.title: The canteen
canteen.brief: The staff canteen at lunchtime: a counter, a coffee bar, a snack trolley and a fruit stand, each with a queue for something better coming from the kitchen.

lines.intro: Lunch. You look like you need it.

renumbered.title: Floor four
renumbered.brief: A junction on floor four: three corridors leading off, a wall sign, a floor plan, a colleague, and a screen with building notices.

lines.intro: Meeting room 4.12. It's on this floor somewhere.
lines.giveup: Nobody has found 4.12 since the weekend. The door behind you will do.

labels.signInspect: A directions sign for floor four.
labels.mapInspect: The floor plan. Someone has drawn on it.

pitch.title: The board pitch
pitch.brief: A boardroom: a long table with board members, a projector screen and a lectern.

lines.intro: The board has a slot free. The lectern is yours, if you want it.
lines.made: The board nods. Somebody writes something down.
lines.sat: The board moves on to other business.

labels.confText: The finance director pays more for accurate odds.
labels.meterText: Press E as it crosses the highlight.

loan.title: The coffee nook
loan.brief: A small coffee nook where two colleagues are chatting by the machine.

lines.intro: The coffee here runs on tokens. You have ten.
lines.cheated: Payday. They seem to have forgotten.

labels.lendText: Every token lent through the staff scheme is tripled on payday, and I'll share it back.
labels.returnTitle: “I put some in the scheme for you. It came to {received}. Share some back?”

lockdown.title: The meeting suite
lockdown.brief: A meeting suite of two rooms joined by an open doorway: one nearly empty with a single chair, the other with a desk piled with unsorted files.

lines.start: Security drill. Please remain in the meeting suite until it is lifted. It's only a drill.
lines.drill: The drill is still in progress.
